intentEvidence: This plugin lets you quickly navigate between headers and fold them.
problem: Users need an efficient way to navigate and manage the structure of long markdown notes by jumping between headers and collapsing sections.

relations.evidence: This tool is very much influenced by the functions provided by emacs org-mode.
This plugin was based on the obsidian sample plugin.

summary: A header navigation plugin that allows users to quickly jump between headers and toggle their folding status within the Obsidian markdown editor.
